title: Alert
description: Alert time and analysis windows of one run (03 §2.6): the protocol, t_alert after the onset shift, the half-open baseline and incident windows clamped to the data span, and the detector that fired under the detected protocol. Written by core's alert step (pipeline step 1); engines from Signalyth on read it instead of any injection time.

protocol.description: Alert protocol of the run (config core.alert.protocol): oracle and live take case_manifest.t_alert_hint_ns, detected calls the alert detector on telemetry.

t_alert_ns.description: Alert time in ns after the onset shift: exactly the base time (hint or detector breach) plus shift_ns, for every protocol.

shift_ns.description: Onset shift in ns = core.alert.shift_s (an int, seconds) x 10^9; 0 unless an onset-shift robustness run.

detector.description: Detector that produced the base alert time; non-null if and only if protocol is detected (enforced by the if/then/else below).

anyOf.title: AlertDetector
anyOf.description: Breach found by the alert detector on the entry service(s).

entry_services.description: Entry services the detector watched, sorted (UTF-8 byte order).

signal.description: Signal whose sustained SLO breach fired the alert, e.g. latency_p99 or error_rate (free string; signal names are documented by Signalyth).

threshold.description: Breach threshold applied to signal, in that signal's unit.

windows.title: AlertWindows
windows.description: Analysis windows around t_alert_ns from config core.windows, each half-open [start_ns, end_ns) and clamped to [data_start_ns, data_end_ns + 1); contiguous windows are allowed.

clamped.description: True if either window was shortened by clamping to the data span.
